Name: Produce Category Swapper
Description:
This mod lets you change the categories of specific vanilla produce to fit your preferences. This also will change the artisan goods from each item, for example you can make Tomato Wine from a Tomato rather than Tomato Juice.

This is only for vanilla items and will not edit modded items.

[b]You have to configure this mod! It has a lot of options, so you have to choose for yourself which ones you like when installing. [/b]Using GMCM to access the config is the best option. Otherwise by default, this mod will only follow vanilla categories.

Please be warned that this will only affect new items (so newly harvested, newly foraged), and any existing items will keep their old categories.

Please be warned that the [b]raccoon quests[/b] can ask for impossible items after changing an item category. If this happens, you can briefly change your setting back to vanilla, use CJB Item Spawner to spawn the requested item (or make it in a machine), and then switch the category back afterwards.

[b]Items included in this mod:
Hot Pepper:[/b] fruit to vegetable
[b]Leek:[/b] forage to vegetable
[b]Snow Yam:[/b] forage to vegetable
[b]Winter Root:[/b] forage to vegetable
[b]Cave Carrot:[/b] forage to vegetable
[b]Cactus Fruit:[/b] fruit to vegetable
[b]Rhubarb:[/b] fruit to vegetable
[b]Coconut:[/b] Fruit to Forage
[b]Truffle:[/b] add forage category
[b]Eggplant:[/b] vegetable to fruit
[b]Pumpkin:[/b] vegetable to fruit
[b]Summer Squash:[/b] vegetable to fruit
[b]Tomato:[/b] vegetable to fruit
[b]Holly:[/b] forage to fruit
[b]Sweet Gem Berry:[/b] add fruit category
[b]Daffodil:[/b] forage to flower
[b]Dandelion: [/b]forage to flower

For translators: Please upload your translation separately, I don't update my smaller mods often.
